criteria.text: The member has a diagnosis of moderately to severely active Crohn's disease or moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis. Disease severity must be described by the treating provider (for example, by symptom burden, a validated disease activity index, or endoscopic severity).
evidence_needed: Chart note from treating provider documenting diagnosis of Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis
Provider's description of disease severity as moderate to severe (symptom burden, validated disease activity index score, or endoscopic severity)

criteria.text: The record includes at least one of the following, dated within the 12 months before the request: (a) an endoscopy, colonoscopy, or flexible sigmoidoscopy report describing active inflammation (such as ulceration, erosions, or friability); or (b) a fecal calprotectin result above the upper limit of the performing laboratory's reference range. An elevated C-reactive protein or erythrocyte sedimentation rate alone does not satisfy this criterion. Imaging alone does not satisfy this criterion.
evidence_needed: Endoscopy, colonoscopy, or flexible sigmoidoscopy report dated within 12 months before the request describing active inflammation (ulceration, erosions, or friability), OR
Fecal calprotectin result dated within 12 months before the request, above the performing laboratory's upper limit of reference range

criteria.text: The medication is prescribed by, or in consultation with, a gastroenterologist.
evidence_needed: Prescription or order identifying a gastroenterologist as prescriber, or
Documentation of consultation with a gastroenterologist

criteria.text: The member is 18 years of age or older.
evidence_needed: Member date of birth showing age 18 or older on the date of the request

criteria.text: Both of the following are documented: (a) conventional therapy and (b) anti-TNF therapy, as specified in the sub-criteria. The record must name each drug, give approximate start and stop dates, and state why it was stopped. Prior therapy must be supported by pharmacy or medical claims, prescription records, or treating-provider chart notes. A treating-provider history without supporting records may be accepted on prescriber attestation. If claims or other records on file are inconsistent with the reported history, the request is referred for clinical review and is not approved on the reported history alone.
evidence_needed: Medication history listing each prior drug with approximate start and stop dates and reason stopped
Pharmacy or medical claims, prescription records, or treating-provider chart notes supporting the history, or prescriber attestation if no records exist
Confirmation that claims or records on file are consistent with the reported history (inconsistency requires clinical review)

sub_criteria.text: An inadequate response to, intolerance of, or contraindication to at least one conventional therapy: systemic corticosteroids, azathioprine, 6-mercaptopurine, or methotrexate; for ulcerative colitis, oral aminosalicylates (such as mesalamine) also count. An inadequate response to corticosteroids includes steroid dependence (relapse during taper or within 3 months of stopping) and steroid-refractory disease. Budesonide counts as a corticosteroid for this purpose.
evidence_needed: Record of at least one trial of systemic corticosteroid, azathioprine, 6-mercaptopurine, methotrexate (or oral aminosalicylate for ulcerative colitis) with documented inadequate response, intolerance, or contraindication
For corticosteroid failure: documentation of steroid dependence (relapse during taper or within 3 months of stopping) or steroid-refractory disease; budesonide qualifies as a corticosteroid

sub_criteria.text: An inadequate response to, intolerance of, or contraindication to at least one tumor necrosis factor (TNF) blocker: adalimumab or infliximab, including any biosimilar of either. Primary non-response, secondary loss of response, and intolerance each qualify. A contraindication must be specifically documented (for example, demyelinating disease or moderate to severe heart failure).
evidence_needed: Record of at least one adalimumab or infliximab (including biosimilar) trial with documented primary non-response, secondary loss of response, or intolerance
Or a specifically documented contraindication (for example, demyelinating disease or moderate to severe heart failure)

criteria.text: The member has a negative tuberculosis screening test (interferon-gamma release assay or tuberculin skin test) dated within the 12 months before the request. An indeterminate interferon-gamma release assay is not a negative result. If the screening test is positive, the record must show that active tuberculosis has been excluded by chest imaging and that treatment for latent tuberculosis has been started.
evidence_needed: Negative interferon-gamma release assay or tuberculin skin test result dated within 12 months before the request
If screening positive: chest imaging report excluding active tuberculosis AND documentation that latent tuberculosis treatment has started
Indeterminate IGRA does not count as negative

criteria.text: Results of both hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) and total hepatitis B core antibody (anti-HBc) are on file. There is no lookback limit for this criterion. If either result is positive, the record must include a plan for monitoring or antiviral prophylaxis. Hepatitis B vaccination history, or a hepatitis B surface antibody (anti-HBs) result alone, does not satisfy this criterion. A test that has been ordered but not resulted does not satisfy this criterion.
evidence_needed: Resulted HBsAg test on file
Resulted total anti-HBc test on file
If either result is positive: documented plan for monitoring or antiviral prophylaxis
Not satisfied by vaccination history, anti-HBs alone, or tests ordered but not resulted

criteria.text: Ustekinumab will not be used together with another biologic agent, a Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor (such as tofacitinib or upadacitinib), or a sphingosine 1-phosphate (S1P) receptor modulator (such as ozanimod or etrasimod). If the member is switching from one of these agents, the record must show that the prior agent has been or will be stopped.
evidence_needed: Current medication list showing no concurrent biologic, JAK inhibitor, or S1P receptor modulator
If switching from one of these agents: documentation that the prior agent has been stopped or will be stopped

criteria.text: The requested dose follows the FDA-approved adult labeling for the indication. Induction: a single intravenous dose based on body weight: 260 mg for 55 kg or less; 390 mg for more than 55 kg up to 85 kg; 520 mg for more than 85 kg. Maintenance: 90 mg subcutaneously every 8 weeks, starting 8 weeks after the intravenous dose. A current body weight (within 30 days of the request) must be documented for the induction dose. Maintenance intervals shorter than every 8 weeks are not approved on initial authorization.
evidence_needed: Current body weight documented within 30 days of the request
Requested induction dose matching weight band (260 mg for 55 kg or less; 390 mg for more than 55 kg up to 85 kg; 520 mg for more than 85 kg)
Maintenance request of 90 mg subcutaneously every 8 weeks, starting 8 weeks after the IV dose; intervals shorter than every 8 weeks do not qualify

criteria.text: The requested product is a preferred product (ustekinumab-aekn or ustekinumab-ttwe, intravenous or subcutaneous form). A non-preferred product, including the reference (originator) product, is covered only when one of the following is documented: (a) an inadequate response to, or intolerance of, both preferred products; or (b) a contraindication or documented hypersensitivity to an inactive ingredient present in both preferred products and absent from the requested product. Intolerance of one preferred product does not satisfy (a). The request must name the specific product; a request for 'ustekinumab' without a product is incomplete.
evidence_needed: Request names the specific ustekinumab product (a generic 'ustekinumab' request is incomplete)
If preferred product (ustekinumab-aekn or ustekinumab-ttwe) is requested: no further documentation needed under this criterion

If non-preferred product is requested: documented inadequate response or intolerance to both ustekinumab-aekn and ustekinumab-ttwe, OR documented contraindication or hypersensitivity to an inactive ingredient present in both preferred products and absent from the requested product

sub_criteria.text: An inadequate response to, or intolerance of, both preferred products (ustekinumab-aekn and ustekinumab-ttwe). Intolerance of only one preferred product does not satisfy this requirement.
evidence_needed: Documented inadequate response or intolerance to ustekinumab-aekn
Documented inadequate response or intolerance to ustekinumab-ttwe

sub_criteria.text: A contraindication or documented hypersensitivity to an inactive ingredient that is present in both preferred products and absent from the requested product.
evidence_needed: Documented contraindication or hypersensitivity to an inactive ingredient present in both ustekinumab-aekn and ustekinumab-ttwe and absent from the requested product
